title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Play noughts and crosses against the computer. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard — on Hard the computer never makes a mistake, so the best you can do is a draw!
instructions: You are X and the computer is O. Take turns placing your mark.
Get three in a row — across, down or diagonally — to win.
Click or tap a square, or press keys 1–9 (top-left is 1). Arrow keys move between squares.
Pick a difficulty at the bottom. Press N for a new round.
